nodes.summary: Let $n$, $p$ and $r$ be natural numbers such that every prime $q > n$ satisfies $q \ge r$. If $p$ is a prime with $n! + 1 < p < n! + r^2$, then $p - n!$ is prime.
nodes.title: Prime gaps near $n!$, general form

nodes.summary: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $r$ be the smallest prime greater than $n$. If $p$ is a prime with $n! + 1 < p < n! + r^2$, then $p - n!$ is prime.
nodes.title: Prime gaps near $n!$

nodes.summary: Let $q < r$ be consecutive primes, so that no prime lies strictly between them, and let $q\#$ be the primorial of $q$, the product of all primes at most $q$. If $p$ is a prime with $q\# + 1 < p < q\# + r^2$, then $p - q\#$ is prime.
nodes.title: Primes just above a primorial (Čejchan–Křížek–Somer)

nodes.summary: Let $q$ and $r$ be natural numbers such that no prime $s$ satisfies $q < s < r$, and let $q\#$ be the primorial of $q$, the product of all primes at most $q$. If $p$ is a prime with $q\# + 1 < p < q\# + r^2$, then $p - q\#$ is prime.
nodes.title: Primes just above a primorial, general form

nodes.summary: Let $q < r$ be consecutive primes and let $q\#$ be the primorial of $q$, the product of all primes at most $q$. If $p$ is a prime with $q\# + 1 < p < q\# + r^2$, then $p - q\#$ is prime.
nodes.title: Primes just above a primorial, for a consecutive-prime pair

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
